description: Tree-level two-block overlaps F_Psi(v2,u2;v3,u3;M) = <(v2 x u2)^(L-M) (x) (v3 x u3)^M | Psi0> of the saved ABJM su(4) highest-weight cyclic states (data/abjm-hw-states.wxf), L = 2,3,4 pairs, M = 0..L. Bras are row vectors, bilinear (no conjugation), site 1 = A, A site carries v, F site carries u, pair k = sites (2k-1,2k); the first L-M pairs carry (v2,u2), the last M pairs (v3,u3). F is a polynomial of multidegree (L-M,L-M,M,M) in (v2,u2,v3,u3). HW trick: F is invariant under (v,u) -> (v n, u n^-T) for upper-unitriangular n (all four vectors) and torus covariant with weight w (A e_i: +eps_i, F e_j: -eps_j). N+ invariants: a2=v2_1, a3=v3_1, d2=u2_4, d3=u3_4, mv=v2_1*v3_2-v2_2*v3_1, mu=u2_3*u3_4-u2_4*u3_3, p22=v2.u2, p23=v2.u3, p32=v3.u2, p33=v3.u3. Key 'bps' = polarisations with p22=p33=0 imposed (monomials without p22,p33; unique and complete: the dimension of the N+-invariant space equals the number of monomials, checked for all weights, M, L<=4); key 'full' = no BPS condition (all ten invariants). Each entry has 'terms' = list of {exp: exponents of (a2,a3,d2,d3,mv,mu,p22,p23,p32,p33), c: [re,im]} and 'expr' = sympy-parsable string in the invariants. Reduced variables x=p23/(a2*d3), y=p32/(a3*d2), muv=mv/(a2*a3), muu=mu/(d2*d3): F/F_vac = sum_k c_k x^e8 y^e9 muv^e5 muu^e6 (bps) with F_vac = (a2*d2)^(L-M)*(a3*d3)^M; see 'reduced_bps'. Coefficients are numerical (states are accurate to about 1e-13; invariant-fit residual <= 3.4e-15 over all 184 states and all M); the phase of each state is the saved one (largest component real positive). 'F16_full' and 'F16_bps_nf' (L=2,3 only) are sympy strings of the full 16-variable polynomial and of its normal form modulo v2.u2, v3.u3 (leading terms v2_1*u2_1, v3_1*u3_1 eliminated). 'class' classifies the BPS form: kinematic_zero (no invariant monomial of that weight/degree), dynamical_zero (monomials exist, all coefficients vanish), no_pairing_dependence (p23,p32 absent, s=0), needs_both_pairings (every term has e8>=1 and e9>=1), survives_p23=0_only (some term has e8=0, none has e9=0), survives_p32=0_only, survives_either_pairing_zero. Generated 2026-10-12 by the python exploration behind twoblock-polarisation-forms.wb (the notebook recomputes L=2,3 symbolically and L=4 pointwise and checks against this file).

conventions.bra_action: A site v -> v g, F site u -> u g^{-T}; pairing v.u invariant

note_polarisation.C_M_equals: F/F_vac at this point = saved C[2(L-M)]

conventions.structure_count: N(L,M,[p,q,r]) = max(0, min(s,n2-e5,n3-e6) - max(0,s-n3+e5,s-n2+e6) + 1); e5=(2q+r-p)/4, e6=(p+2q-r)/4 (muv, muu powers), s=L-(p+2q+r)/2=e8+e9 (total pairing power), n2=L-M, n3=M
conventions.exponents_bps: a2^e1 a3^e2 d2^e3 d3^e4 mv^e5 mu^e6 p23^e8 p32^e9 with e1=n2-e5-e8, e2=n3-e5-e9, e3=n2-e6-e9, e4=n3-e6-e8
